author: dhrumil9398

title: Highly disappointed.
body:
The app is great, I used it for a year on premium and it delivered all that was promised. The problem begins with the premium subscription. Since I purchased it on 11th Jan, 2022, I should get premium features till 11th Jan, 2023. However, for the past few days the app has been restricting my ability to add new habits and it is consistently pushing me to upgrade to premium, even though I am already on a premium subscription. 

Made me unsubscribe and move to another app. Sorry, but messing around like this at the start of a new year when most people aim to update their habits is bad for business for a habit app.

title: Great app love it. Sync buggy
body:
I love the app and have purchased the subscription but iCloud sync fails repeatedly which is annoying and renders the app useless for me.

Update:
The sync issue was fixed by turning iCloud Drive in the settings. A request to developer to please include appropriate instructions in the error copy. 

now that that’s fixed the app deserves 5 stars all the way

title: Great App but widget can be better!
body: The app looks helpful but I’d give it a full five star if the widget was better.
